goal.hit.text: Target reached. What happens next stays your secret until you write it.
{target} words, target reached. The story is bigger than it was.
Target reached. Whoever is in this chapter has had a busy day.
Target reached. I did a small leap. The jar held.

goal.progress.text: {pct}% of the target. There's more story than there was.
{pct}% there. Somewhere in those words, someone did something new.
{count} words so far, {pct}% of the target. I'm pressed against the glass.

snapshot.saved.text: Snapshot saved. This version of the story is kept, whatever happens next.
Snapshot saved. In this copy, everyone stays exactly as they are.
Saved. This moment of the story, kept safe in a drawer.

app.failed.text: Something didn't go through just now. Worth a look.
That didn't work. I'll stay in my jar while you check.
Something went wrong a moment ago. Have a look when you can.

session.long.text: {minutes} minutes inside this story. I've circled the jar the whole time.
A long session. The people in this story have had plenty of company.
{minutes} minutes. Salmon make long journeys too.
Past midnight. I wonder what time it is in the story.

stuck.offer.text: If you want to think out loud about someone in this story, click me.
Synonyms are a right-click away. Or click me and we can talk about the place where this happens.
I can stay quiet in my jar. Or click me and tell me who's here.

pause.long.text: No hurry. The people in this story know how to wait.
I'm watching the hazelnut float. It's very restful.
I wonder what the weather is doing wherever this story is.
{remaining} words to the target. Everyone in the story can wait.

writer.returning.text: Everyone in “{doc}” is where you left them.
{words} words of story, all still there. I kept the jar steady.
The story's people stayed put. Nobody goes anywhere without you.

offer.snapshot.text: A long spell of revising. Shall I keep a snapshot of this version? Everyone in it would stay exactly where they are.
Lots of changes, and no snapshot yet. I can keep one, in case you want this version back.
Before the next change, a snapshot, if you like. I'd keep it safe in the jar.

offer.bible.text: {title} again. I'd like to know more too. Shall I look it up?
{count} visits to {title}. Shall I search the project for it? I'd love to see where it turns up.
